answer: The plume test I would run is Proof of unique water bill account with water company attestation: years the company billed one household at one address, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the bridge of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the atlas of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
